headline: OpenAI nears $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of potential 2027 IPO
summary: Artificial intelligence lab OpenAI has approached a valuation of $1.25 trillion as it weighs preparations for a potential public offering.
why: Private valuations of leading artificial intelligence developers set pricing benchmarks for the broader technology sector and signal future venture exit trends.

impacts.name: Artificial Intelligence
impacts.why: Soaring private valuations reflect aggressive capital allocation and high growth expectations across generative AI developers.
